apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vllm-decode
  namespace: companion
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8000
    targetPort: 8000
  selector:
    app: vllm-decode
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vllm-prefill
  namespace: companion
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8000
    targetPort: 8000
  selector:
    app: vllm-prefill
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vllm-decode
  namespace: companion
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vllm-decode
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vllm-decode
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: companion-vllm
        hami.io/webhook: ignore
        llm-d.ai/role: decode
    spec:
      containers:
      - args:
        - $(MODEL)
        - --served-model-name=companion
        - --port=8200
        - --max-model-len=32768
        - --max-num-seqs=24
        - --max-num-batched-tokens=2560
        - --block-size=64
        - --enable-prefix-caching
        - --scheduling-policy=priority
        - --gpu-memory-utilization=0.90
        - --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager
        - --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        - --enable-auto-tool-choice
        - --tool-call-parser=gemma4
        - --reasoning-parser=gemma4
        - --limit-mm-per-prompt={"image":2}
        - --disable-access-log-for-endpoints=/health,/metrics,/v1/models
        - --kv-transfer-config
        - '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"backends":["UCX"]}},{"kv_connector":"LMCacheMPConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"lmcache.mp.host":"tcp://$(HOST_IP)","lmcache.mp.port":5555,"lmcache.mp.isolated_ipc":true}}]}}'
        - --kv-events-config
        - '{"enable_kv_cache_events":true,"publisher":"zmq","endpoint":"tcp://*:5556","replay_endpoint":"tcp://*:5559","topic":"kv@$(POD_IP):8000@$(MODEL)"}'
        command:
        - vllm
        - serve
        env:
        - name: MODEL
          value: RedHatAI/gemma-4-31B-it-FP8-dynamic
        - name: HF_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              key: HF_TOKEN
              name: companion-secrets
        - name: POD_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.podIP
        - name: HOST_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        - name: VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.podIP
        - name: VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE
          value: '120'
        - name: PYTHONHASHSEED
          value: '123'
        - name: UCX_TLS
          value: cuda_ipc,cuda_copy,tcp
        - name: HF_HOME
          value: /models/hf
        - name: VLLM_CACHE_ROOT
          value: /models/vllm-cache
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0
        livenessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 3
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        name: modelserver
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8200
          name: http
        - containerPort: 5556
          name: kv-events
        - containerPort: 5559
          name: kv-replay
        - containerPort: 5600
          name: nixl
        readinessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 3
          httpGet:
            path: /v1/models
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 96Gi
            nvidia.com/gpu: '1'
          requests:
            cpu: '12'
            memory: 64Gi
            nvidia.com/gpu: '1'
        startupProbe:
          failureThreshold: 180
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: shm
        - mountPath: /models
          name: models
      hostIPC: true
      initContainers:
      - args:
        - --port=8000
        - --kv-connector=nixlv2
        - --zap-log-level=1
        - --secure-proxy=false
        image: ghcr.io/llm-d/llm-d-router-disagg-sidecar:v0.11.0
        name: routing-proxy
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
          name: sidecar
        restartPolicy: Always
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
      nodeSelector:
        companion.io/node: gpu
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      volumes:
      - emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
          sizeLimit: 20Gi
        name: shm
      - hostPath:
          path: /lambda/nfs/companion-state/models
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
        name: models
---

        - name: VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST

        - name: UCX_TLS

        - name: HF_HOME

        - name: VLLM_CACHE_ROOT

        ports:

        - containerPort: 5556

          requests:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
      hostIPC: true
      nodeSelector:

      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      volumes:
      - emptyDir:

      - hostPath:

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  labels:
    app: lmcache-server
  name: lmcache-server
  namespace: companion
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: lmcache-server
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: lmcache-server
    spec:
      containers:
      - command:
        - lmcache
        - server
        - --l1-size-gb
        - '250'
        - --eviction-policy
        - LRU
        - --port
        - '5555'
        - --host
        - $(HOST_IP)
        - --http-host
        - $(HOST_IP)
        - --isolated-ipc
        - --eviction-trigger-watermark
        - '0.9'
        env:
        - name: HOST_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        - name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
          value: all
        - name: PYTHONHASHSEED
          value: '123'
        image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0
        name: lmcache
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5555
          name: lmcache
        - containerPort: 8080
          name: metrics
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 270Gi
          requests:
            cpu: '4'
            memory: 260Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: shm
      hostIPC: true
      hostNetwork: true
      nodeSelector:
        companion.io/node: gpu
      volumes:
      - hostPath:
          path: /dev/shm
        name: shm

  - pluginRef: token-load-scorer

  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 2.0
  - pluginRef: ramp-scorer

  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 2.0

    weight: 2.0

  priorityBands:
  - priority: 10
    defaultRequestTTL: 10s
    fairnessPolicyRef: round-robin-fairness-policy

router_policy:
# Our router policy (system design sections 6.2 to 6.5). We own these numbers.
# `python -m control.router.render` turns this file into:
#   - the llm-d EndpointPickerConfig (flow control, scheduling profiles, P/D decider, warm gate, ramp)
#   - the InferenceObjectives (priority bands)
#   - the Agent Router tenant windows (AIGatewayRoute token costs and a BackendTrafficPolicy)
# Values are start values. The experiments tune them (E3, E5, E10, E11).

model_name: RedHatAI/gemma-4-31B-it-FP8-dynamic
served_model_name: companion
namespace: companion
pool: companion-router   # the router chart names the InferencePool after the Helm release (install.sh, G0)
gateway: companion-gateway

# prefix_then_load | least_loaded | random (system design section 6.3; E3 switches it)
policy: prefix_then_load
# precise: KV events from vLLM (default). approx: request history only (E7 arm A).
prefix_index: precise
# decider: option C (default). always: option B. off: option A, one profile with the role prefill-decode.
pd_mode: decider
pd_non_cached_tokens: 2048

# Must equal the vLLM --block-size on every pod (issue 52234) and the KV-event block size.
block_size_tokens: 64
kv_events:
  socket_port: 5556
  replay_socket_port: 5559
  topic_filter: "kv@"
render_service_url: http://localhost:8000   # the router chart tokenizer sidecar (tokenizer.enabled); VERIFY at G0
router_chart:
  epp_image_tag: v0.11.0                    # fallback v0.10.0 if the G0 smoke test fails
  failure_mode: FailClose                   # a router outage must not bypass admission and flow control
  model_server_labels: {app.kubernetes.io/part-of: companion-vllm}
  target_port: 8000

weights:
  decode: {prefix: 3, session: 2, queue: 2, kv_util: 2, ramp: 2}
  prefill: {prefix: 3, token_load: 2, queue: 2, ramp: 2}

warm:
  label: companion.io/warm
  ramp_label: companion.io/ramp
  ramp_weights: {r10: 0.10, r25: 0.25, r50: 0.50, r100: 1.00}

flow_control:
  default_request_ttl: 60s
  bands:
    - {objective: interactive, priority: 10, ttl: 10s}
    - {objective: batch, priority: 0, ttl: 120s}
  fairness: round-robin-fairness-policy
  ordering: fcfs-ordering-policy        # E10 compares edf-ordering-policy
  usage_limit: priority-holdback-policy
  # llm-d v0.11 needs minCeiling (G0, 2026-09-28). Batch (the lowest band) waits above 70% saturation;
  # interactive (the highest band) waits only at 100%.
  usage_limit_parameters: {minCeiling: 0.7, maxCeiling: 1.0}
  saturation:
    queue_depth_threshold: 5
    kv_cache_util_threshold: 0.90
    metrics_staleness_threshold: 2s
    staleness_policy: saturated           # class7 rule: unknown is not idle

tenants:
  owner: {tokens_per_minute: 600000, requests_per_minute: 300}
  sweep: {tokens_per_minute: 300000, requests_per_minute: 120}
  noisy: {tokens_per_minute: 60000, requests_per_minute: 60}
load_tenants:
  count: 32                               # load-1 to load-32 (app/loadgen/replay.py LOAD_TENANTS): the load
                                          # reaches the engine limit before the tenant windows
  tokens_per_minute: 400000
  requests_per_minute: 240
